svg.text: Everyday English - Quote
A thoughtful question can
open a door that a quick
answer leaves closed.
MEANING
Taking time to ask well can reveal possibilities that an
immediate answer overlooks.
IN CONTEXT
Before advising a colleague, Lena said, “A thoughtful
question can open a door that a quick answer leaves
closed.” She asked what was making the decision
difficult.
USAGE NOTE
Open a door means create a possibility. Leaves closed
suggests an opportunity remains unexplored. Use the
contrast to encourage curiosity before giving advice.
CONVERSATION
A: Should I just tell him to change jobs?
B: “A thoughtful question can open a door that a quick
answer leaves closed.”
A: Then I could ask what he wants from his work.
B: Yes. His answer may reveal another option.
YOUR TURN
Replace a quick piece of advice with a thoughtful
question. Model: Instead of “Quit,” ask “What would
make staying worthwhile?”
